about: The epistola of the formulary “Saint Lawrence, Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Brethren: He who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly; and he who sows in blessings will also reap from blessings. Each one as he has decided in his heart, not from sadness or from necessity; for it is a cheerful giver that God loves. God, moreover, is able to cause every grace to abound among you, so that, always having all sufficiency in all things, you may abound in every good work, even as it is written: He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor; his justice remains for ever and ever. Now He who provides seed for the sower will both give bread to eat, and multiply your seed, and increase the growth of the harvest of your justice.
